RORK MAX — P0 IVX CHAT LATENCY + TRUE LIVE TYPING FINAL FIX, make ivx ia chat  faster respond audit QA fix 

I AM PROVIDING A REAL OWNER SCREEN RECORDING.

THE CURRENT PRODUCTION CHAT STILL FAILS OWNER ACCEPTANCE.

THIS IS NOT A QA REPORT REQUEST.

INSPECT THE ACTUAL RECORDING BEHAVIOR,
FIND THE CODE CAUSING IT,
MODIFY THE REAL CODE,
DEPLOY IT,
AND VERIFY THE LIVE APP.

DO NOT GIVE ME ANOTHER CERTIFICATION BEFORE THE UX ACTUALLY WORKS.

==================================================
OWNER OBSERVED DEFECT
==================================================

The screen recording proves:

1. User sends a message.
2. Input clears.
3. IVX takes too long before useful answer text becomes visible.
4. The user cannot see what IVX is actually generating during the wait.
5. Loading/responding/thinking UI has previously remained visible too long.
6. Circular/spinner-style loading UI is not wanted anywhere in normal chat.
7. When the answer finishes, ALL responding/thinking/loading state must stop immediately.

OWNER REQUIREMENT:

NO CIRCULAR LOADER.

NO SPINNER.

NO ROTATING ICON.

NO BLOCKING LOADING UI.

NO FAKE TYPING.

NO POST-ANSWER "THINKING".

==================================================
1. REQUIRED FINAL NORMAL CHAT EXPERIENCE
==================================================

NORMAL CHAT MUST BE:

USER SEND
→ user message renders immediately
→ one small text indicator:
   "IVX is responding..."
→ REAL provider response begins
→ first REAL text delta immediately appears in assistant bubble
→ indicator disappears on first delta
→ subsequent real deltas append continuously
→ response completes
→ stream closes
→ all pending/responding/thinking state becomes FALSE
→ no loader remains

The owner must be able to WATCH THE ACTUAL ANSWER BEING GENERATED.

Not character animation after completion.

Not simulated typing.

REAL MODEL STREAM.

==================================================
2. REMOVE THE CIRCULAR LOADER COMPLETELY
==================================================

Search the entire production chat render tree for every source of:

ActivityIndicator
Spinner
Loader
CircularProgress
rotation
Animated.loop
isLoading
loading
pending
responding
thinking
generating
streaming

The OWNER DOES NOT WANT A CIRCULAR LOADER in normal IVX IA chat.

Remove it from:

initial request
provider wait
streaming
persistence
post-completion
retry

Normal chat may have only the small textual pre-token indicator.

==================================================
3. FIX POST-ANSWER THINKING STATE
==================================================

This is mandatory.

When response.completed fires:

set all appropriate state to final immediately:

isResponding = false
isThinking = false
isLoading = false
isGenerating = false
isStreaming = false
pendingRequest = null

Abort/close stream reader where appropriate.

Clear timers/subscriptions.

Do not leave:

"IVX is responding..."
typing
spinner
thinking
working

visible after final assistant text.

Also clean state on:

error
abort
conversation change
navigation
component unmount
retry

==================================================
4. TRACE THE REAL LATENCY
==================================================

Instrument ONE production request end-to-end.

Record actual timestamps:

T0 = Send pressed
T1 = frontend fetch starts
T2 = backend request received
T3 = authentication complete
T4 = context/database retrieval complete
T5 = routing/brain processing complete
T6 = AI provider request begins
T7 = provider first delta
T8 = backend emits first SSE delta
T9 = frontend receives first delta
T10 = first visible text rendered
T11 = provider completes
T12 = persistence completes
T13 = UI returns to idle

Calculate:

SEND → FETCH
AUTH TIME
DATABASE/CONTEXT TIME
ROUTING/BRAIN TIME
PROVIDER TTFT
BACKEND STREAM DELAY
NETWORK DELAY
REACT RENDER DELAY
TIME TO FIRST VISIBLE TOKEN
TOTAL GENERATION TIME
POST-COMPLETION CLEANUP TIME

Find the largest IVX-controlled delay.

FIX IT.

==================================================
5. DO NOT BLOCK STREAMING ON PRE-WORK
==================================================

Audit whether the request waits for unnecessary operations before
starting the provider stream.

Investigate:

identity brain
conversation brain
memory retrieval
business context
Supabase reads
authorization
task detection
autonomous detection
logging
proof generation
conversation persistence

Anything non-critical that can happen after streaming starts
must NOT block time-to-first-token.

Critical context only before provider call.

Non-critical writes/logging/evidence may complete asynchronously
after response starts where safe.

==================================================
6. REAL STREAMING — PROVE THE FULL CHAIN
==================================================

Prove actual path:

MODEL PROVIDER STREAM
→ backend stream reader
→ response.delta SSE event
→ network
→ frontend ReadableStream/EventSource reader
→ React state update
→ assistant message text visible

For the live test record:

DELTA 1 timestamp + length
DELTA 2 timestamp + length
DELTA 3 timestamp + length
...
FINAL delta count

Do not just say:
"streaming implemented."

Prove visible incremental rendering.

==================================================
7. DO NOT BUFFER DELTAS
==================================================

Inspect for accidental buffering:

- waiting for full fetch response
- response.text()
- response.json()
- accumulating server response before send
- large batching threshold
- frontend batching until completion
- state updates only after stream closes

Each provider text delta should reach the visible assistant message
as quickly as reasonably possible.

==================================================
8. CHAT MESSAGE PLACEHOLDER
==================================================

Create ONE assistant message placeholder when the request begins.

On each real delta:

append delta to the SAME message.

Example:

assistantMessage.body += delta

Do NOT:

create one message per token
wait until completion
remove/recreate the bubble
flash the layout

At completion:

persist the canonical final assistant message once.

==================================================
9. AUTOSCROLL DURING STREAMING
==================================================

While user is near the bottom:

keep streamed answer visible naturally as it grows.

Do not jump violently.

If user manually scrolls upward:

do not force them back down.

==================================================
10. SENIOR DEVELOPER RESPONSE BEHAVIOR
==================================================

The owner also reports IVX does not yet communicate like a real
senior software developer.

FOR ENGINEERING QUESTIONS:

Answer technically and directly.

Example structure:

ROOT CAUSE
FIX
FILES / COMPONENT
VERIFICATION

Do NOT automatically generate:

BUSINESS IMPACT
generic recommendations
marketing language
long narrative status reports

unless asked.

FOR REAL ENGINEERING EXECUTION:

After owner approval:

Task <real ID> started.
Current real stage: <stage>.

Then execution status must come from backend events.

Do not narrate fake work.

==================================================
11. REAL AUTONOMOUS TASK FAILURE
==================================================

The owner previously received:

FAILED
"Autonomous coder blocked"

Do not leave this as a generic error.

Trace the latest failed real task.

Identify exact:

task ID
worker
stage
error
HTTP response
credential binding
repository action
retry state

Fix the root cause if IVX-controlled.

If transient:
retry automatically using SAME task + SAME owner authorization.

Do not repeatedly ask:

"Do you authorize me?"

for the same approved scope.

==================================================
12. RESPONSE LANGUAGE
==================================================

Preserve existing language behavior:

Spanish prompt → Spanish response
English prompt → English response

No regression.

==================================================
13. REAL DEVICE OWNER-LIKE QA
==================================================

Do not certify from unit tests alone.

Test the same production behavior seen in the owner's recording.

TEST A:

"¿Cuál es tu nombre?"

Required:

- message visible immediately
- NO circular loader
- one small responding text before first delta
- Spanish words begin appearing progressively
- responding indicator disappears at first visible delta
- answer finishes
- ZERO loading/thinking state afterward

TEST B:

"Explain why a React Native list can become slow."

Required:

- no autonomous task
- no spinner
- first text streamed quickly
- senior technical response
- clean completion state

TEST C:

A longer business question.

Required:

- progressive real text throughout generation
- no long blank waiting state

TEST D:

Real software task.

Owner authorizes once.

Required:

- real Task ID
- real worker events
- real code action
- no fake percentage
- automatic recovery where safe

==================================================
14. PERFORMANCE ACCEPTANCE
==================================================

Do NOT invent a fixed number if provider/network conditions vary.

But production must demonstrate:

A. No unexplained multi-second IVX-controlled dead time before
   provider request.

B. Once provider emits first delta, frontend displays it immediately.

C. No buffering of full response.

D. No loading state after completion.

Report actual measured TTFT.

If TTFT is slow because provider itself is slow,
prove provider T6→T7 separately.

==================================================
15. TESTS
==================================================

Add/regress tests for:

- no ActivityIndicator in normal chat
- no spinner component
- responding text before first delta
- first delta hides responding text
- delta 1 renders without waiting for completion
- multiple deltas update same assistant message
- response.completed clears every loading flag
- error clears every loading flag
- abort clears every loading flag
- navigation clears active state safely
- no post-answer thinking indicator
- Spanish remains Spanish
- normal technical question does not create autonomous job
- approved autonomous retry does not request duplicate approval

==================================================
16. DEPLOYMENT
==================================================

After real code fix:

RUN TESTS
COMMIT
PUSH OWNER GITHUB
MERGE
DEPLOY
VERIFY RUNTIME

Prove:

GITHUB SHA
=

Rork-local code does not count as deployed.
